{{Top|leg}}
An '''ion-charged dishrag''' was one of the cleaning tool created from the template of the [[vibromop]]. Ion-charged dishrags were considered new and exciting.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|History of the Vibro-mop}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ion-charged dishrags were mentioned in the Codex entry for the History of the Vibro-mop in the [[2015]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']] to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]].<ref name="Codex" />
